title: Slime Ball crafting recipe
description: This mod adds a cheap crafting recipe for slimeballs.
body:
This mod adds a cheap crafting recipe for slime, because it can be a pain to get slime.

![1 kelp = 1 slimeball](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/4d87500253a519c83095f06b0370a85eb18e5329.png)
